tickets.text: Add: my danger point is structural (C17): a daily close back below structure_shift_ref, not a percentage loss from cost. The weekly LH/LL makes this a recovery, not a weekly markup (C16).

Add: the words 'must bring volume' print no level; I read them as my sign-of-strength test, vol_x_ge:1.2 with clv_ge:0.67 (R6, C12), since the break came on day_vol 1.01. My danger point is the wrong-if's second half, a close back under pivot_high (C17).
Add: the fade_atr_ge:1 wrong-if is not a structural danger point; mine is a daily close half an ATR below structure_shift_ref (C17). Short weekly history limits the top-down read (C16).
Add: the wrong-if at the 50-day sits well below the broken level; on my method the test has failed at a daily close back under structure_shift_ref (C17), before the 50-day is reached.
Add: the trading zone for the corrective wave is the broken level and value, not only the 20-day average (C3, C7); 'pullback toward the 20-day' is the first zone the wave may reach, not the only one.

Add: the trading zone is the broken level and value, not only the 20-day average (C3, C7); the last push came on day_vol 0.81, light volume, so the pullback must prove supply is absent before the trigger counts (C5).
Add: 'once the reaction ends' names no zone; on my method the reaction should end at a test of the broken level on light volume (C7) before the hourly trigger counts. Bearish divergence noted.
Add: on structure alone the volume-expansion daily close is exactly the proof a below-average-volume break owes (C5).
Add: a range at its upper edge with a fired bearish divergence: a break that re-enters the range is an upthrust (C5). The wrong-if should add a close back under pivot_high, not wait for the base low.
